summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, announcing that the SEC declared effective its Form S-4 registration statement, which includes a proxy statement/prospectus for the previously disclosed July 30, 2025 business combination with Everli Global Inc., a Nevada corporation, under an amended merger agreement. The filing discloses no deal price, stake, or premium. The definitive proxy was mailed to Melar shareholders of record as of September 28, 2026, who will vote on the transaction. Watch the shareholder vote outcome and redemption levels, the key arbitrage variables for the de-SPAC.
